text:
# claim D01 | iac | 2026-01-12 | superseded
Migrate Relay infrastructure code from Terraform to CloudFormation, module by module, finishing by end of Q1. Superseded by D09.
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Pavel Grishin; objection from Timur Aliev. Recorded in ADR-001.
Source: meetings/2026-01-12-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D02 | slo | 2026-01-26 | superseded
Delivery SLO: p95 end-to-end delivery latency 2 s over 5 minutes; monthly delivery success rate 99.5%. Superseded by D28.
Owner: Lena Kim. Proposed by Lena Kim.
Source: meetings/2026-01-26-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D03 | iac | 2026-02-09 | active
One CloudFormation root stack per environment with nested stacks per component (network, data, compute, gateway).
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Pavel Grishin.
Source: meetings/2026-02-09-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D29 | cost | 2026-02-09 | active
Every Relay AWS resource carries cost-center and env tags; untagged resources fail the CloudFormation lint.
Owner: Olga Petrova. Proposed by Olga Petrova.
Source: meetings/2026-02-09-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D04 | iac | 2026-02-23 | active
Manual console changes are frozen; nightly drift detection on every stack with alerts to on-call.
Owner: Lena Kim. Proposed by Lena Kim.
Source: meetings/2026-02-23-incident-review.txt.

# claim D05 | gateway | 2026-03-02 | active
Front Relay with the API gateway; the gateway and its routes are defined in the gateway nested stack.
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Pavel Grishin. Recorded in ADR-002.
Source: meetings/2026-03-02-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D06 | timeouts | 2026-03-16 | superseded
Gateway integration timeout 10 s on every Relay route. Superseded by D12.
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Pavel Grishin; objection from Anna Sokolova.
Source: meetings/2026-03-16-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D30 | security | 2026-03-23 | active
Callers authenticate to the gateway with IAM-signed requests; the old shared API key is retired by 2026-04-30.
Owner: Yulia Tarasova. Proposed by Yulia Tarasova.
Source: meetings/2026-03-23-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D07 | retries | 2026-03-30 | superseded
Retries disabled on POST /deliver at the gateway until idempotency keys exist; read routes may retry twice. Superseded by D14.
Owner: Nikita Frolov. Proposed by Nikita Frolov.
Source: meetings/2026-03-30-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D08 | database | 2026-04-06 | active
Evaluate DynamoDB as the replacement for DocumentDB with PoC-1 comparing single-table and multi-table designs.
Owner: Denis Orlov. Proposed by Denis Orlov. Recorded in ADR-003.
Source: meetings/2026-04-06-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D09 | iac | 2026-04-20 | active
Hybrid IaC: networking (VPC, peering, DNS) stays in Terraform; application stacks are CloudFormation.
Supersedes D01.
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Sergey Belov; objection from Pavel Grishin. Recorded in ADR-004.
Note: docs/iac-cloudformation.md (updated 2026-02-11) still says all infrastructure including networking moves to CloudFormation
Source: meetings/2026-04-20-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D10 | database | 2026-05-04 | active
DynamoDB single-table design, chosen on PoC-1 results (p99 read 4 ms vs 11 ms; 38% lower cost at projected volume).
Owner: Denis Orlov. Proposed by Denis Orlov; objection from Timur Aliev. Recorded in ADR-003. Based on poc-1.
Note: confluence/architecture.xhtml (updated 2026-03-12) still shows DocumentDB
Source: meetings/2026-05-04-poc-review.txt.

# claim D11 | idempotency | 2026-05-18 | active
Idempotency-Key header mandatory on POST /deliver from 2026-06-01; keys kept 24 h; two-week grace period.
Owner: Nikita Frolov. Proposed by Nikita Frolov.
Source: meetings/2026-05-18-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D12 | timeouts | 2026-05-18 | superseded
Gateway integration timeout raised from 10 s to 30 s after the slow-target incident of 2026-05-14.
Supersedes D06. Superseded by D20.
Owner: Pavel Grishin. Proposed by Anna Sokolova; objection from Lena Kim.
Note: docs/gateway.md (updated 2026-03-18) still says the integration timeout is 10 s; ADR-002 section Timeouts is stale since 2026-05-18
Source: meetings/2026-05-18-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D13 | ownership | 2026-06-01 | active
Retries and idempotency ownership moves from Nikita to Anna (Nikita leaves on 2026-06-01).
Owner: Anna Sokolova. Proposed by Marat Yusupov.
Note: docs/onboarding.md (updated 2026-03-10) still lists Nikita as retries owner and does not list Sergey or Ivan
Source: meetings/2026-06-01-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D14 | retries | 2026-06-15 | superseded
Retries enabled on POST /deliver at the gateway: max 3 attempts, retry budget 15%.
Supersedes D07. Superseded by D21.
Owner: Anna Sokolova. Proposed by Anna Sokolova.
Note: docs/gateway.md (updated 2026-03-18) still says retries are disabled on /deliver; confluence/decision-log.xhtml (updated 2026-06-03) still stops at 2026-06-01
Source: meetings/2026-06-15-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D15 | compute | 2026-06-15 | superseded
Run two compute PoCs in parallel: EKS with autoscaling (Timur) and Lambda (Sergey); decide on cost and p95 by end of July. Superseded by D17.
Owner: Timur Aliev. Proposed by Timur Aliev. Recorded in ADR-005.
Source: meetings/2026-06-15-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D16 | ownership | 2026-07-13 | active
Serverless PoC ownership moves from Sergey to Ivan.
Owner: Ivan Melnik. Proposed by Pavel Grishin.
Source: meetings/2026-07-13-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D17 | compute | 2026-08-03 | active
Relay moves to Lambda with provisioned concurrency on /deliver; PoC-3 showed 41% lower monthly cost and p95 1.9 s with warm instances.
Supersedes D15.
Owner: Ivan Melnik. Proposed by Olga Petrova; objection from Timur Aliev. Recorded in ADR-006. Based on poc-3.
Note: confluence/architecture.xhtml (updated 2026-03-12) still shows EKS as the runtime; confluence/migration-roadmap.xhtml (updated 2026-06-20) still lists compute decision as pending PoC
Source: meetings/2026-08-03-architecture-committee.txt.

# claim D18 | compute | 2026-08-03 | rejected
Keep Relay on EKS with autoscaling (rejected: p95 0.4 s but 1.7x the monthly cost and a second platform to run).
Owner: Timur Aliev. Proposed by Timur Aliev. Recorded in ADR-007. Based on poc-2.
Source: meetings/2026-08-03-architecture-committee.txt.

# claim D19 | database | 2026-08-10 | active
DynamoDB migration dry run on a production snapshot is owned by Sergey, due 2026-09-04.
Owner: Sergey Belov. Proposed by Marat Yusupov.
Note: docs/db-migration-plan.md (updated 2026-05-26) still says the dry run has no owner
Source: meetings/2026-08-10-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D20 | timeouts | 2026-08-24 | active
Gateway integration timeout lowered from 30 s to 25 s: the gateway's hard limit is 29 s and Lambda needs headroom.
Supersedes D12.
Owner: Ivan Melnik. Proposed by Ivan Melnik.
Source: meetings/2026-08-24-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D21 | retries | 2026-08-24 | active
Retries move out of the gateway into SQS with a dead-letter queue after 5 attempts; gateway retries on /deliver are turned off.
Supersedes D14.
Owner: Anna Sokolova. Proposed by Ivan Melnik; objection from Anna Sokolova. Recorded in ADR-009.
Note: docs/gateway.md (updated 2026-03-18) still describes gateway retries at all; ADR-002 section Retries is stale since 2026-08-24
Source: meetings/2026-08-24-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D22 | ownership | 2026-09-07 | active
Retries ownership moves from Anna to Ivan, who owns the SQS pipeline.
Owner: Ivan Melnik. Proposed by Anna Sokolova.
Note: confluence/team-roster.xhtml (updated 2026-07-08) still lists Anna as retries owner
Source: meetings/2026-09-07-security-review.txt.

# claim D23 | security | 2026-09-07 | active
Secrets are read from SSM Parameter Store at startup; no secrets in Lambda environment variables or CloudFormation parameters.
Owner: Yulia Tarasova. Proposed by Yulia Tarasova. Recorded in ADR-008.
Source: meetings/2026-09-07-security-review.txt.

# claim D24 | cost | 2026-09-21 | active
Monthly budget alert for Relay production at $4,000, page finance partner and platform lead at 80%.
Owner: Olga Petrova. Proposed by Olga Petrova.
Source: meetings/2026-09-21-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim D25 | cutover | 2026-10-05 | active
Serverless cutover on 2026-10-19 at 09:00 local, inside the planned-work error budget.
Owner: Ivan Melnik. Proposed by Ivan Melnik.
Note: docs/runbook-cutover-serverless.md (updated 2026-09-29) still has no cutover date
Source: meetings/2026-10-05-cutover-planning.txt.

# claim D26 | database | 2026-10-05 | active
DynamoDB cutover on 2026-10-12, one week before the compute cutover, with dual-write stopped on 2026-10-26.
Owner: Denis Orlov. Proposed by Denis Orlov.
Note: docs/documentdb-runbook.md (updated 2026-02-02) still describes DocumentDB as the system of record; docs/db-migration-plan.md (updated 2026-05-26) still has no cutover date
Source: meetings/2026-10-05-cutover-planning.txt.

# claim D27 | cutover | 2026-10-05 | active
Rollback owner for both cutovers is Lena.
Owner: Lena Kim. Proposed by Marat Yusupov.
Note: docs/runbook-cutover-serverless.md (updated 2026-09-29) still says rollback owner TBD
Source: meetings/2026-10-05-cutover-planning.txt.

# claim D28 | slo | 2026-10-05 | active
Delivery p95 SLO relaxed from 2 s to 3 s for 30 days after the serverless cutover, then back to 2 s.
Supersedes D02.
Owner: Lena Kim. Proposed by Lena Kim; objection from Marat Yusupov.
Note: docs/slo.md (updated 2026-01-28) still says p95 2 s with no stabilisation window
Source: meetings/2026-10-05-cutover-planning.txt.

# claim O1 | database | raised 2026-05-04 | closed
OPEN ITEM: DynamoDB migration dry run on a production snapshot. Raised 2026-05-04, raised again on 2026-05-18, 2026-06-15, 2026-06-29, 2026-07-20. No owner. Closed by D19.
Source: meetings/2026-05-04-poc-review.txt.

# claim O2 | cutover | raised 2026-08-24 | closed
OPEN ITEM: Rollback runbook for the serverless cutover. Raised 2026-08-24. Owner: Lena Kim since 2026-09-21.
Source: meetings/2026-08-24-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim O3 | compute | raised 2026-07-27 | open
OPEN ITEM: Load test on Lambda at 10x current volume. Raised 2026-07-27, raised again on 2026-08-17, 2026-09-14. No owner.
Source: meetings/2026-07-27-poc-review.txt.

# claim O4 | database | raised 2026-05-18 | open
OPEN ITEM: DocumentDB decommission date. Raised 2026-05-18, raised again on 2026-08-10, 2026-10-05. No owner.
Source: meetings/2026-05-18-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim O5 | iac | raised 2026-04-20 | closed
OPEN ITEM: Terraform state cleanup for modules already moved to CloudFormation. Raised 2026-04-20. Owner: Pavel Grishin since 2026-04-27.
Source: meetings/2026-04-20-weekly-sync.txt.

# claim O6 | compute | raised 2026-08-03 | closed
OPEN ITEM: Provisioned concurrency sizing for /deliver. Raised 2026-08-03. Owner: Ivan Melnik since 2026-08-10.
Source: meetings/2026-08-03-architecture-committee.txt.

# claim O7 | security | raised 2026-09-07 | open
OPEN ITEM: Rotate DocumentDB credentials before decommission. Raised 2026-09-07, raised again on 2026-09-28. No owner.
Source: meetings/2026-09-07-security-review.txt.

# claim O8 | iac | raised 2026-02-23 | closed
OPEN ITEM: Route drift-detection alerts to on-call. Raised 2026-02-23. Owner: Lena Kim since 2026-03-02.
Source: meetings/2026-02-23-incident-review.txt.

Pavel Grishin owns iac from 2026-01-12 (current).

Pavel Grishin owns gateway from 2026-03-02 (current).

# claim ownership | database | 2026-04-06
Denis Orlov owns database from 2026-04-06 (current).

# claim ownership | slo | 2026-01-26
Lena Kim owns slo from 2026-01-26 (current).

# claim ownership | security | 2026-03-23
Yulia Tarasova owns security from 2026-03-23 (current).

# claim ownership | cost | 2026-02-09
Olga Petrova owns cost from 2026-02-09 (current).

# claim ownership | idempotency | 2026-05-18
Nikita Frolov owns idempotency from 2026-05-18 to 2026-06-01.

# claim ownership | idempotency | 2026-06-01
Anna Sokolova owns idempotency from 2026-06-01 (current).
